[[Hardcore Mode|{{Color|HardcoreMode}}]] |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]60 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (4) |spawned_by = [[Fallen Reaper]] (wave 25 onwards) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Slash}}''' - Slashes its axe onto towers, applying a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Soul''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It can only be summoned by the [[Fallen Reaper]] when it uses its ability from wave 25 onwards. It does not appear naturally. While it has low health and above average speed, its main ability is to slash at towers with its axe. This will apply a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to towers, increasing their firerate and decreasing their DPS, not inclusive of the [[Firerate Bug]]. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of completely stopping it and prevents it from being knocked back. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Soul''' appears to be a knight about the same size as the [[Abnormal]]. Its entire body has a dark, reflective complexion. It has black armor that has a purple gem at the front and skull shoulder-pads that have purple eyes, similar to the [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]]. Its helmet has black horns. It wields an axe on its right arm. This axe is held upside down, similar to the [[Fallen Swordmaster]]. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *As this enemy is decently fast but weak, Level 3 [[Military Base]]s can deal with these quickly. **The [[Humvee 2]] and [[Humvee 3]] can instantly kill the '''Fallen Soul''' by colliding with it. **However, they might come in swarms from the [[Fallen Reaper]], so prepare any high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]]. *It is recommended to place your towers away from the path to prevent the '''Fallen Soul''' from attacking and debuffing them. *Because this spawns along with the minions of the [[Fallen Reaper]], it will be paired up with [[Invisible]]s, [[Hefty|Hefties]] and [[Fallen]]s. Make sure your towers have hidden detection to deal with the [[Invisible]]s, and that your DPS is high enough to deal with the [[Hefty|Hefties]] and [[Fallen]]s. *A [[Commander]] should be placed to boost the firerate of nearby towers, both passively and with its ''Call to Arms''. **If any towers are hit by the '''Fallen Soul''', the [[Commander]] can mitigate some of the effects. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFallenSoul.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexLegacyFallenSoul.png|'''Fallen Soul''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Unlike the [[Soul]] and [[Soul Boss]], this is not a hidden or ghost enemy. *The helmet worn by the '''Fallen Soul''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|335080498|Winged Helm of the Redcliff Elite}} hat from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Fallen Soul''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **{{Bug}} Has no attack animation in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} Now has an attack animation in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Fallen Soul''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Fallen Soul}}
